title: Strategic Structural Intelligence and Competitive UIRTU-Relay (SSICR)
description:
Strategic Structural Intelligence and Competitive UIRTU-Relay (SSICR) develops a proposed research framework for strategic interactions among autonomous subjects using cooperative, competitive, adversarial, and hybrid UIRTU-Relay structures.

The framework connects strategic subject boundaries and control planes, massive multi-strategy simulation, context-dependent comparative advantage maps, strategic worldview forests, social and institutional co-evolution, open-ended structural recursive self-improvement (RSI), and human strategic sovereignty. Its central aim is to turn AI-scale strategic exploration into contestable, auditable, context-aware knowledge while keeping consequential goals, values, and decisions under legitimate human authority.

Version 1.0.0 contains ten research manuscripts, four proposed technical specifications, three illustrative case studies, architectural figures, and an open-questions, testable-hypotheses, and validation-roadmap package. The specifications are proposals rather than adopted standards; the cases are illustrative, and the hypotheses have not been established by empirical experiments. This release is intended to invite critical examination, replication, counter-evidence, and further research.
